bio: The senior Mender of Kesselford's dawn pair; sings the ford clear and counts the notes that come back late.
context_line: Ivo sings the ford open every dawn and, lately, only ever in a pair, so someone is there to catch the note that does not come back.
dialogue_hostile: The charter does not oblige me to speak with you.
dialogue_warm: Walk with us at dawn, if you want to hear what the river says back.
